title: 第6082章 见到君太一第6081章 公平竞争对决狱无双
lines: 猛！
猛烈至极！
这狂暴而猛烈的神念风暴席卷，在风暴的内部，更是蕴藏着一股掌控天地，囚禁一切，镇压一切的无上意志。
隐隐之间，狱无双体内，似乎有某种可怕的规则一下子爆发了。
这神念一击，动用了规则之力？
这种手段，倒是特殊。
就算是叶寒，也没有这样的技巧，未曾修炼过能够将规则融入神念，随意之间一击爆发的手段。
这样的神念大碰撞……
极其之凶险。
几乎，任何相同境界的高手，和这狱无双进行神念比拼，恐怕都要落入下风，甚至当场变成傻子，被狱无双的神念重创。
可惜，在今日，没有用。
叶寒冷哼一声，本尊神念同样爆发。
他并不能够真正彰显自己比肩终焉之主的“一极”
之神念，那太过惊世骇俗。
但是，这一刹显化出比肩起源始祖的强横神念，却是没有任何顾虑。
同样猛烈的神念风暴席卷起来，在与此同时……
叶寒不着痕迹看了一眼皇城的深处，然后催动出了君家的无上秘术：至尊神念术。
至尊神念术一运转，本尊神念……
瞬息之间，就增强了数倍。
汹涌莫测的神念风暴中心，诞生出了一柄近乎于虚无的天刀。
天意如刀，再度施展。
哧啦！
真空像是被叶寒一个念头再度撕裂开来。
天意如刀的刀体，夹杂在神念风暴之中，简直是切割虚无，屠戮一切。
在这一刹那之间，两道神念风暴产生了猛烈的撞击。
空间不停地震荡着，浩浩荡荡的意念彼此产生了无形的生死大对决。
叶寒露出意外之色。
这一击之间，虽然并不是巅峰神念，但也理应能够直接碾压眼前的狱无双才对。
没想到……
两道神念风暴，居然在此刻纠缠在了一起。
一个呼吸！
两个呼吸！
三个呼吸！
短短三个呼吸，叶寒就感觉到，那狱无双的神念好像化作虚无的牢笼，要把自己的神念包裹、囚禁、镇压在其中。
以至于，叶寒本尊的神魂，都不禁颤悸了一瞬。
居然莫名感受到了一股危机。
好在，这一切，只持续到第四个呼吸，便戛然而止。
神念的差距，终究太大了。
恍惚之中，天意如刀的刀体，像是斩破了一座恐怖虚无牢笼。
content_en:
fierce!
猛烈至极！
This violent and fierce storm of spiritual thoughts swept across, and inside the storm, there was a supreme will that controlled the world, imprisoned everything, and suppressed everything.
Faintly, there seemed to be some kind of terrible rules that suddenly broke out in Ji Wushuang's body.
This divine attack used the power of rules?
This method is quite special.
Even Ye Han does not have such skills, and has never practiced the method of integrating rules into spiritual thoughts and bursting out with a single blow at will.
Such a great collision of spiritual thoughts...
极其之凶险。
Almost any master of the same level who competes with this Jigou Wushuang in a spiritual competition will probably be at a disadvantage, or even turn into a fool on the spot and be severely injured by Jigou Wushuang's spiritual thoughts.
Unfortunately, today, it is of no use.
Ye Hanhan snorted, and his spiritual thoughts also exploded.
He is not able to truly show that he is "one pole" comparable to the Lord of the End.
His divine thoughts were too shocking.
However, at this moment, he showed a powerful spiritual thought that was comparable to the ancestor of the origin, but he had no worries.
The same violent spiritual storm swept across, and at the same time...
Ye Han glanced at the depths of the imperial city without leaving a trace, and then activated the Jun family's supreme secret technique: the Supreme Divine Mind Technique.
As soon as the Supreme Spiritual Thought Technique is activated, the divine thoughts of the deity...
In an instant, it increased several times.
In the center of the turbulent and unpredictable storm of spiritual thoughts, a heavenly sword that was close to nothingness was born.
God's will is like a sword, it is used again.
哧啦！
The vacuum seemed to be torn open again by Ye Han's thought.
The blade of God's Will is like a sword, mixed in the storm of spiritual thoughts, simply cutting through nothingness and killing everything.
At this moment, two spiritual storms violently collided.
The space was constantly vibrating, and the vast thoughts formed an invisible life-and-death showdown with each other.
Ye Han looked surprised.
In this blow, although it is not the peak of divine consciousness, it should be able to directly crush the prison in front of him.
Unexpectedly...
The two storms of spiritual thoughts were actually entangled at this moment.
一个呼吸！
两个呼吸！
三个呼吸！
In just three breaths, Ye Han felt that the incomparable spiritual thoughts seemed to turn into a cage of nothingness, trying to wrap, imprison, and suppress his spiritual thoughts in it.
As a result, Ye Han's soul could not help but tremble for a moment.
I actually felt a crisis inexplicably.
Fortunately, all this only lasted until the fourth breath and then came to an abrupt end.
The gap between spiritual thoughts is too big after all.
In a trance, the sword body of God's Will seemed to have cut through a terrifying prison of nothingness.
